module: Third-party library lua-resty-template: small HTML tag generator. `html.name(attributes)(content)` or `html.name(content)` produces `<name attr="...">content</name>` with HTML escaping of the content and attribute values. It also registers itself as `template.html`.
usage: local html = require('resty.template.html') print(html.a{href = '/x'}('lien')) -- lien print(html.br()) --
notes: The file does `require "resty.template"` (dot separator) while the module is in libs/resty/template: this name must be resolvable by the require search path.
If the content is not a string, the tag is self-closing (` />`). Attributes with a numeric key are written as is (escaped), the others as key="value".
Attribute values are escaped with template.escape: '/' becomes /.
